detail.longDescription: Claude Academy is a great new resource for anyone looking to become more effective with Claude AI. It offers courses, tutorials, and practical use cases covering everything from Claude fundamentals and AI fluency to Claude Code, APIs, agents, MCP, and enterprise workflows. For developers, the Building with the Claude API course covers prompting, tool use, RAG, agents, MCP, and production patterns. There are also dedicated courses for Claude Code, Model Context Protocol, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex AI. For anyone using generative AI professionally, I especially like the focus on AI fluency—understanding not just what AI can do, but its limitations and how to collaborate with it effectively. Definitely worth checking out if you’re looking to build practical AI skills rather than just experiment with AI tools. https:// academy.claude.com/ # AI # ArtificialIntelligence # GenerativeAI # ClaudeAI # Anthropic # ClaudeCode # AIEngineering # MachineLearning # MCP # Developers # Tech
